Image Collector fixtures

Open this page as http://localhost:8000/. Images from 127.0.0.1:8000 count as cross-origin.

  • Formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, SVG, data:, blob:, duplicates
  • Responsive and lazy images: srcset, picture, data-src placeholder
  • Frames and cross-origin: same-origin iframe, cross-origin iframe, non-CORS image
  • Huge images: run python3 test/make-fixtures.py --huge first
